#!/usr/bin/env node
'use strict';
/*
  Night Run: the complete game in one file (Node.js 18+, no dependencies).
  This file IS the game plus its backend: run it and open http://localhost:3000
  (the game page is embedded at the bottom; `node night-run-server.js --export` writes it out as night-run.html).
  - Accounts: nickname + password (8-16 chars), scrypt-hashed
  - Sessions: random bearer tokens, stored hashed, 30-day expiry
  - Cloud saves, per-account
  - Public leaderboard (best score per nickname)
  - Serves night-run.html at "/" so the game and API share one origin

  Run:   node server.js
  Env:   PORT, HOST, DATA_FILE, GAME_FILE (optional override), ALLOWED_ORIGIN, TRUST_PROXY, BLOCKED_WORDS, SIGNUP_LIMIT, ADMIN_NICKNAMES
*/
const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'), crypto = require('crypto');
const scrypt = require('util').promisify(crypto.scrypt);

const CFG = {
  port: +process.env.PORT || 3000,
  host: process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0',
  data: process.env.DATA_FILE || path.join(__dirname, 'data.json'),
  game: process.env.GAME_FILE || '',                 // optional: serve this file instead of the embedded game
  origin: process.env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN || '',          // '' = same-origin only; set to your game's origin if hosted elsewhere
  proxy: process.env.TRUST_PROXY === '1',            // set to 1 only behind a reverse proxy you control
  blocked: (process.env.BLOCKED_WORDS || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean),
  admins: (process.env.ADMIN_NICKNAMES || '').split(',').map(s => s.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean)   // nicknames allowed to use the admin panel
};
const RESERVED = ['admin', 'administrator', 'moderator', 'mod', 'system', 'staff', 'support', 'nightrun', 'root'];
const NICK = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _.-]{1,14}[A-Za-z0-9]$/;
const SESSION_MS = 30 * 864e5, MAX_SAVE = 300 * 1024, MAX_BODY = 400 * 1024;

/* ---------- storage (JSON file, atomic writes) ---------- */
let db = { users: {}, sessions: {} };
try { db = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(CFG.data, 'utf8')); }
catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ENOENT') { console.error('Cannot read', CFG.data, '-', e.message); process.exit(1); } }
db.users = db.users || {}; db.sessions = db.sessions || {}; db.audit = db.audit || [];
let dirty = false, scheduled = false;
function persist() { dirty = true; if (!scheduled) { scheduled = true; setTimeout(flush, 300); } }
function flush() {
  scheduled = false; if (!dirty) return; dirty = false;
  try { fs.writeFileSync(CFG.data + '.tmp', JSON.stringify(db)); fs.renameSync(CFG.data + '.tmp', CFG.data); }
  catch (e) { console.error('Write failed:', e.message); dirty = true; }
}
function purgeSessions() { const n = Date.now(); for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].exp < n) delete db.sessions[h]; persist(); }
purgeSessions(); setInterval(purgeSessions, 36e5).unref();
for (const sig of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM']) process.on(sig, () => { flush(); process.exit(0); });

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
const buckets = new Map();
function allow(key, max, win) {
  const now = Date.now(); let b = buckets.get(key);
  if (!b || b.r < now) { b = { n: 0, r: now + win }; buckets.set(key, b); }
  return ++b.n <= max;
}
setInterval(() => { const n = Date.now(); for (const [k, b] of buckets) if (b.r < n) buckets.delete(k); }, 6e4).unref();

const ipOf = req => CFG.proxy ? ((req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] || '').split(',')[0].trim() || req.socket.remoteAddress) : req.socket.remoteAddress;
const sha = s => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex');
const pwOk = p => typeof p === 'string' && p.length >= 8 && p.length <= 16 && !/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/.test(p);
const hashPw = async (pw, saltHex) => (await scrypt(pw.normalize('NFKC'), Buffer.from(saltHex, 'hex'), 64, { N: 16384, r: 8, p: 1 })).toString('hex');
const same = (a, b) => { const x = Buffer.from(a), y = Buffer.from(b); return x.length === y.length && crypto.timingSafeEqual(x, y); };
const isAdmin = key => CFG.admins.includes(key);
function audit(by, action, target, detail) { db.audit.push({ t: Date.now(), by, action, target: target || '', detail: detail || '' }); if (db.audit.length > 300) db.audit.splice(0, db.audit.length - 300); persist(); }
// An admin nickname can only be registered from the server machine itself (no proxy headers), or while ADMIN_SIGNUP_OPEN=1 is set.
function adminSignupAllowed(req) {
  if (process.env.ADMIN_SIGNUP_OPEN === '1') return true;
  const ra = req.socket.remoteAddress || '';
  return ['127.0.0.1', '::1', '::ffff:127.0.0.1'].includes(ra) && !req.headers['x-forwarded-for'] && !req.headers['forwarded'] && !req.headers['x-real-ip'];
}
const DUMMY_SALT = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');

function headers(extra) {
  const h = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'Referrer-Policy': 'no-referrer' };
  if (CFG.origin) { h['Access-Control-Allow-Origin'] = CFG.origin; h['Vary'] = 'Origin'; h['Access-Control-Allow-Headers'] = 'Authorization, Content-Type'; h['Access-Control-Allow-Methods'] = 'GET, POST, PUT, OPTIONS'; }
  return Object.assign(h, extra);
}
function send(res, status, obj) { res.writeHead(status, headers()); res.end(JSON.stringify(obj)); }
const fail = (res, status, error) => send(res, status, { error });

function readBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let size = 0; const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', c => { size += c.length; if (size > MAX_BODY) { reject({ status: 413, msg: 'Request too large.' }); req.destroy(); } else chunks.push(c); });
    req.on('end', () => { try { resolve(chunks.length ? JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')) : {}); } catch (e) { reject({ status: 400, msg: 'Invalid JSON.' }); } });
    req.on('error', () => reject({ status: 400, msg: 'Bad request.' }));
  });
}

function newSession(key) {
  const token = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('base64url');
  db.sessions[sha(token)] = { u: key, exp: Date.now() + SESSION_MS };
  const mine = Object.entries(db.sessions).filter(([, s]) => s.u === key).sort((a, b) => a[1].exp - b[1].exp);
  while (mine.length > 10) delete db.sessions[mine.shift()[0]];           // keep the 10 newest sessions per account
  persist(); return token;
}
function authed(req) {
  const m = /^Bearer (\S+)$/.exec(req.headers.authorization || ''); if (!m) return null;
  const h = sha(m[1]), s = db.sessions[h];
  if (!s || s.exp < Date.now() || !db.users[s.u] || db.users[s.u].banned) return null;
  const u = db.users[s.u], now = Date.now(); u.seen = now; if (now - (u.seenP || 0) > 6e4) { u.seenP = now; persist(); }
  return { key: s.u, user: u, hash: h };
}
function profile(u) {
  let save = u.save ? JSON.parse(u.save) : null;
  if (u.pending && save) { save.money = Math.max(0, (+save.money || 0) + u.pending); u.save = JSON.stringify(save); u.pending = 0; persist(); }
  return { nickname: u.nick, best: u.best || 0, save, admin: isAdmin(u.nick.toLowerCase()) };
}

/* ---------- routes ---------- */
async function api(req, res, url) {
  const ip = ipOf(req), route = req.method + ' ' + url.pathname;

  if (route === 'GET /api/health') return send(res, 200, { ok: true, game: 'night-run' });

  if (route === 'POST /api/signup') {
    if (!allow('su:' + ip, +process.env.SIGNUP_LIMIT || 5, 36e5)) return fail(res, 429, 'Too many sign-ups from this address. Try again later.');
    const b = await readBody(req), nick = typeof b.nickname === 'string' ? b.nickname.trim() : '';
    if (!NICK.test(nick) || / {2}/.test(nick)) return fail(res, 400, 'Nickname must be 3\u201316 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, _ . -');
    if (!pwOk(b.password)) return fail(res, 400, 'Password must be 8\u201316 characters.');
    const key = nick.toLowerCase(), flat = key.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
    if (RESERVED.includes(flat) || CFG.blocked.some(w => flat.includes(w.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '')))) return fail(res, 400, 'That nickname is not allowed.');
    if (db.users[key]) return fail(res, 409, 'That nickname is already taken.');
    if (isAdmin(key) && !adminSignupAllowed(req)) return fail(res, 403, 'That nickname is reserved.');   // stops anyone else claiming an admin nickname first
    const salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    db.users[key] = { nick, salt, hash: await hashPw(b.password, salt), created: Date.now(), best: 0, bestAt: 0, car: '', runs: 0, save: null, fails: 0, lock: 0 };
    persist();
    return send(res, 201, Object.assign({ token: newSession(key) }, profile(db.users[key])));
  }

  if (route === 'POST /api/login') {
    if (!allow('li:' + ip, 20, 9e5)) return fail(res, 429, 'Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.');
    const b = await readBody(req), key = typeof b.nickname === 'string' ? b.nickname.trim().toLowerCase() : '', u = db.users[key];
    if (typeof b.password !== 'string' || b.password.length > 64) return fail(res, 400, 'Invalid login.');
    if (u && u.lock > Date.now()) return fail(res, 429, 'This account is temporarily locked after too many wrong passwords. Try again later.');
    const h = await hashPw(b.password, u ? u.salt : DUMMY_SALT);            // same work whether or not the account exists
    if (!u || !same(h, u.hash)) {
      if (u && ++u.fails >= 5) { u.fails = 0; u.lock = Date.now() + 5 * 6e4; persist(); }
      return fail(res, 401, 'Wrong nickname or password.');
    }
    u.fails = 0; u.lock = 0;
    if (u.banned) return fail(res, 403, 'This account has been suspended.');
    u.seen = Date.now();
    return send(res, 200, Object.assign({ token: newSession(key) }, profile(u)));
  }

  if (route === 'GET /api/leaderboard') {
    const lim = Math.max(1, Math.min(50, +url.searchParams.get('limit') || 20));
    const rows = Object.values(db.users).filter(u => u.best > 0 && !u.banned).sort((a, b) => b.best - a.best || a.bestAt - b.bestAt)
      .slice(0, lim).map(u => ({ nickname: u.nick, best: u.best, car: u.car }));
    return send(res, 200, { rows });
  }

  const a = authed(req);
  if (!a) return fail(res, 401, 'Please sign in again.');
  if (!allow('au:' + a.key, 240, 6e4)) return fail(res, 429, 'Slow down.');

  if (route === 'GET /api/me') return send(res, 200, profile(a.user));

  if (route === 'POST /api/logout') { delete db.sessions[a.hash]; persist(); return send(res, 200, { ok: true }); }

  if (route === 'PUT /api/save') {
    const b = await readBody(req), s = b.save;
    if (!s || typeof s !== 'object' || Array.isArray(s) || !Array.isArray(s.owned) || s.owned.length > 40 || s.owned.some(x => typeof x !== 'string' || x.length > 20))
      return fail(res, 400, 'Invalid save.');
    const json = JSON.stringify(s);
    if (json.length > MAX_SAVE) return fail(res, 413, 'Save is too large.');
    let delta = 0;
    if (a.user.pending) { delta = a.user.pending; a.user.pending = 0; s.money = Math.max(0, (+s.money || 0) + delta); }
    a.user.save = JSON.stringify(s); a.user.saveAt = Date.now(); persist();
    return send(res, 200, delta ? { ok: true, delta, money: s.money } : { ok: true });
  }

  if (route === 'POST /api/score') {
    const b = await readBody(req), score = Math.floor(+b.score), dist = +b.dist, secs = +b.secs;
    if (![score, dist, secs].every(Number.isFinite) || score < 0 || dist < 0 || secs <= 0 || score > 1e9 || dist > 1e6) return fail(res, 400, 'Invalid run.');
    // Basic plausibility checks only (not anti-cheat): max speed is ~84 m/s, and score is bounded by distance.
    if (dist / secs > 95 || score > dist * 60 + 500) return fail(res, 422, 'Run rejected.');
    a.user.runs = (a.user.runs || 0) + 1;
    if (score > (a.user.best || 0)) { a.user.best = score; a.user.bestAt = Date.now(); a.user.car = String(b.car || '').slice(0, 12); }
    persist();
    return send(res, 200, { best: a.user.best });
  }

  if (route === 'POST /api/password') {
    const b = await readBody(req);
    if (!pwOk(b.newPassword)) return fail(res, 400, 'New password must be 8\u201316 characters.');
    if (typeof b.oldPassword !== 'string' || !same(await hashPw(b.oldPassword, a.user.salt), a.user.hash)) return fail(res, 401, 'Current password is wrong.');
    a.user.salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'); a.user.hash = await hashPw(b.newPassword, a.user.salt);
    for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].u === a.key && h !== a.hash) delete db.sessions[h];
    persist(); return send(res, 200, { ok: true });
  }

  if (route === 'POST /api/account/delete') {
    const b = await readBody(req);
    if (typeof b.password !== 'string' || !same(await hashPw(b.password, a.user.salt), a.user.hash)) return fail(res, 401, 'Wrong password.');
    for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].u === a.key) delete db.sessions[h];
    delete db.users[a.key]; persist(); return send(res, 200, { ok: true });
  }


  /* ---------- admin panel (nicknames listed in ADMIN_NICKNAMES) ---------- */
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/admin/')) {
    if (!isAdmin(a.key)) return fail(res, 403, 'Admin access only.');
    if (!allow('ad:' + a.key, 300, 6e4)) return fail(res, 429, 'Slow down.');
    const now = Date.now();

    if (route === 'GET /api/admin/stats') {
      const us = Object.values(db.users); let bytes = 0; try { bytes = fs.statSync(CFG.data).size; } catch (e) {}
      return send(res, 200, { users: us.length, new24h: us.filter(u => u.created > now - 864e5).length, new7d: us.filter(u => u.created > now - 7 * 864e5).length,
        active24h: us.filter(u => u.seen > now - 864e5).length, suspended: us.filter(u => u.banned).length, runs: us.reduce((n, u) => n + (u.runs || 0), 0),
        sessions: Object.keys(db.sessions).length, topScore: us.reduce((m, u) => Math.max(m, u.best || 0), 0), saves: us.filter(u => u.save).length,
        dataBytes: bytes, uptime: Math.round(process.uptime()), node: process.version });
    }

    if (route === 'GET /api/admin/users') {
      const q = (url.searchParams.get('q') || '').trim().toLowerCase().slice(0, 32), page = Math.max(0, +url.searchParams.get('page') || 0), size = 25;
      const all = Object.entries(db.users).filter(([k]) => !q || k.includes(q)).sort((x, y) => y[1].created - x[1].created);
      const rows = all.slice(page * size, page * size + size).map(([key, u]) => {
        let money = null; try { money = u.save ? JSON.parse(u.save).money : null; } catch (e) {}
        return { key, nickname: u.nick, created: u.created, seen: u.seen || 0, best: u.best || 0, runs: u.runs || 0, money, pending: u.pending || 0,
          banned: !!u.banned, reason: u.banned ? u.banned.reason : '', locked: u.lock > now, admin: isAdmin(key) };
      });
      return send(res, 200, { total: all.length, page, size, rows });
    }

    if (route === 'GET /api/admin/audit') return send(res, 200, { rows: db.audit.slice(-100).reverse() });

    if (route === 'POST /api/admin/user') {
      const b = await readBody(req), key = String(b.key || '').toLowerCase(), u = db.users[key], act = String(b.action || '');
      if (!u) return fail(res, 404, 'No such player.');
      const protectedTarget = isAdmin(key);
      if (protectedTarget && ['ban', 'delete', 'resetPassword', 'rename', 'clearScore'].includes(act)) return fail(res, 403, 'Admin accounts are protected from this action.');
      const done = (message, detail) => { audit(a.user.nick, act, u.nick, detail); return send(res, 200, { ok: true, message }); };
      if (act === 'ban') { u.banned = { at: now, reason: String(b.reason || '').slice(0, 200), by: a.user.nick }; for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].u === key) delete db.sessions[h]; return done(u.nick + ' is suspended and signed out.', u.banned.reason); }
      if (act === 'unban') { delete u.banned; return done(u.nick + ' can sign in again.'); }
      if (act === 'clearScore') { u.best = 0; u.bestAt = 0; u.car = ''; return done('Removed ' + u.nick + ' from the leaderboard.'); }
      if (act === 'unlock') { u.fails = 0; u.lock = 0; return done('Login lock cleared for ' + u.nick + '.'); }
      if (act === 'revokeSessions') { for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].u === key) delete db.sessions[h]; return done(u.nick + ' was signed out everywhere.'); }
      if (act === 'resetPassword') {
        if (!pwOk(b.password)) return fail(res, 400, 'Password must be 8\u201316 characters.');
        u.salt = crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'); u.hash = await hashPw(b.password, u.salt); u.fails = 0; u.lock = 0;
        for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].u === key) delete db.sessions[h];
        return done('Password reset for ' + u.nick + '. Give them the new password and ask them to change it.');
      }
      if (act === 'grant') {
        const amt = Math.round(+b.amount);
        if (!Number.isFinite(amt) || amt === 0 || Math.abs(amt) > 1e6) return fail(res, 400, 'Amount must be a non-zero number up to 1,000,000.');
        u.pending = (u.pending || 0) + amt; return done((amt > 0 ? 'Added $' : 'Removed $') + Math.abs(amt).toLocaleString() + ' for ' + u.nick + '. It applies the next time their game syncs.', String(amt));
      }
      if (act === 'rename') {
        const nick = String(b.nickname || '').trim(), nk = nick.toLowerCase(), flat = nk.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
        if (!NICK.test(nick) || / {2}/.test(nick)) return fail(res, 400, 'Nickname must be 3\u201316 characters: letters, numbers, spaces, _ . -');
        if (RESERVED.includes(flat) || isAdmin(nk)) return fail(res, 400, 'That nickname is not allowed.');
        if (nk !== key && db.users[nk]) return fail(res, 409, 'That nickname is already taken.');
        const old = u.nick; u.nick = nick;
        if (nk !== key) { db.users[nk] = u; delete db.users[key]; for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].u === key) db.sessions[h].u = nk; }
        audit(a.user.nick, 'rename', old, '\u2192 ' + nick); return send(res, 200, { ok: true, message: old + ' is now ' + nick + '.' });
      }
      if (act === 'delete') {
        for (const h in db.sessions) if (db.sessions[h].u === key) delete db.sessions[h];
        const name = u.nick; delete db.users[key]; audit(a.user.nick, 'delete', name); return send(res, 200, { ok: true, message: name + ' was deleted.' });
      }
      return fail(res, 400, 'Unknown action.');
    }
    return fail(res, 404, 'Not found.');
  }

  return fail(res, 404, 'Not found.');
}

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://x');
    if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') { res.writeHead(CFG.origin ? 204 : 405, headers()); return res.end(); }
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return await api(req, res, url);
    if (req.method === 'GET' && (url.pathname === '/' || url.pathname === '/index.html')) {
      const html = gameHtml();
      res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'Referrer-Policy': 'no-referrer',
        'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'none'; script-src 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:; connect-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'" });
      return res.end(html);
    }
    return fail(res, 404, 'Not found.');
  } catch (e) {
    if (e && e.status) return fail(res, e.status, e.msg);
    console.error(e); return fail(res, 500, 'Server error.');
  }
});
server.requestTimeout = 15000;
function gameHtml() {
  if (CFG.game) { try { return fs.readFileSync(CFG.game); } catch (e) { console.error('GAME_FILE not readable, using the embedded game:', e.message); } }
  return Buffer.from(EMBEDDED_GAME, 'base64');
}

/* ---------- embedded game (base64 of night-run.html) ---------- */
const EMBEDDED_GAME = '';

if (process.argv.includes('--export')) {
  fs.writeFileSync('night-run.html', gameHtml()); console.log('Wrote night-run.html'); process.exit(0);
}
server.listen(CFG.port, CFG.host, () => console.log(`Night Run is running on http://${CFG.host}:${CFG.port}  (data: ${CFG.data})`));
